name: Tenkai
source:
"I am the obedient servant of a miko. So please, please be selfish."

A servant of Tenjinmon Kuro. When he was injured and collpased, he was saved by Kuro, who was still a child at the time, and pledged loyalty to her. He is a quick-witted, intelligent general. He has a methodical personality and is a little neurotic, but he is extremely sweet towards Kuro.

Taking care of his master, Kuro, gives him a sense of purpose in life.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_tenkai.png]official website[/url]]

One of Kuro's love interests.
